label: Key Events of an AOP with their role
description: Lists every Key Event of an AOP once, with its role in that AOP: MIE (molecular initiating event), AO (adverse outcome) or KE. aopo:has_key_event already includes the MIEs and AOs, so counting aopo:has_key_event, aopo:has_molecular_initiating_event and aopo:has_adverse_outcome together counts them twice. The role belongs to the AOP, not the Key Event: the same Key Event can be an MIE in one AOP and an intermediate KE in another.
query:
PREFIX aopo: <http://aopkb.org/aop_ontology#>
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>

SELECT ?ke ?title ?role
WHERE {
  VALUES ?aop { <https://identifiers.org/aop/12> }
  ?aop aopo:has_key_event ?ke .
  ?ke dc:title ?title .
  BIND(IF(EXISTS { ?aop aopo:has_molecular_initiating_event ?ke }, "MIE",
       IF(EXISTS { ?aop aopo:has_adverse_outcome ?ke }, "AO", "KE")) AS ?role)
}
ORDER BY ?role ?title
